verdict.rationale: Gladia's live STT quickstart says streaming results come as partial and final transcripts: partials are provisional, and finals complete an utterance. The live docs also cover silence thresholds and maximum utterance duration, which set when an utterance is finalized. missing for 10: the message schema or field names that mark interim versus final events, detail on whether finals can be revised or how partials are superseded, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
